Convert a phyloseq object to MicroBioMeta tables

Source: R/from_objects.R
from_phyloseq.Rd

Extracts the count table, taxonomy and sample metadata of a phyloseq object into the plain data frames that every MicroBioMeta function takes.

Usage

from_phyloseq(physeq)

Arguments

physeq

A phyloseq object with an OTU table and, ideally, a taxonomy table and sample data.

Value

A list with two data frames:

table

Taxa in rows, samples in columns, and a last column taxonomy with the full taxonomic string (e.g. "k__Bacteria; p__Firmicutes; c__Bacilli").

metadata

Sample metadata whose first column, SAMPLEID, holds the sample names of table.

See also

from_tse for (Tree)SummarizedExperiment objects.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("phyloseq", quietly = TRUE)) {
  counts <- matrix(c(10, 0, 5, 3, 8, 1), nrow = 3,
                   dimnames = list(c("ASV1", "ASV2", "ASV3"), c("S1", "S2")))
  tax <- matrix(c("Bacteria", "Bacteria", "Bacteria",
                  "Firmicutes", "Proteobacteria", NA),
                nrow = 3, dimnames = list(rownames(counts), c("Kingdom", "Phylum")))
  samples <- data.frame(Soil = c("Rhizosphere", "Bulk soil"),
                        row.names = c("S1", "S2"))
  ps <- phyloseq::phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(counts, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
                           phyloseq::tax_table(tax),
                           phyloseq::sample_data(samples))
  mbm <- from_phyloseq(ps)
  mbm$table
  mbm$metadata
}
#>   SAMPLEID        Soil
#> 1       S1 Rhizosphere
#> 2       S2   Bulk soil
